name: Audio only
description: Duration plus the transcript and audio features - what can be heard, not seen.
notes: Trained on 144 engineering lecture recordings from two University of Newcastle courses (MECH1750 and ENGG2440 - the EduVideo Insights set, see data/sample/edu-video-insights/COMPARISON.md). Predictions for other kinds of video are extrapolation. The per-feature suggestions are associations in that data, not causes.

model_type.predictor_role: Predicts average percentage viewed from the raw feature values.
model_type.feedback_role: Gives each feature's direction and strength of association with average percentage viewed, used for the per-feature suggestions.

feature_definitions.duration: Video length in minutes (scene stats, or audio stats when the model uses no scene feature).
feature_definitions.wpm: Transcript word count / duration in minutes (Whisper transcript).
feature_definitions.speech_pace_variation: Standard deviation of words per minute across 30 s windows of the transcript.
feature_definitions.speech_ratio: Seconds of speech heard by Silero VAD / video length (0-1).
feature_definitions.mean_pause_secs: Mean length in seconds of the gaps between stretches of speech (Silero VAD).

target_definition: Average percentage viewed: YouTube's average view duration / video duration x 100.

training.split: Random train/test split; metrics are on the held-out test rows.
